title: Strata Sync conformance vector file
description: A table of input to expected output for one named pure function. No state, no clock, no I/O. Asserted directly by each implementation's own test suite, without the driver.

fn.description: The function under test, named as it appears in the TypeScript reference implementation. Ports map it to their own spelling.

requires.description: Capabilities an implementation must declare to be held to this file.

name.description: Unique within the file; used as the test name so a failure names itself.

input.description: Arguments. An array is spread as positional arguments; anything else is passed as a single argument.

expected.description: The return value. Required unless `throws` is set.

throws.description: The call must fail. The message is deliberately not pinned — it is not part of the contract.
